reviews.comment: This was by far one of the best classes I've taken. You do need to put in work to do well, but he gives you all the materials you need to succeed. He is also more than willing to answer questions and help you. If you are genuinely interested in the subject, attend every class, and study all the practice problems you will do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class will require you to put in extra effort if you want a good grade. I recommend attending office hours every week, Hoekstra is a great teacher and wants to help you succeed. Very interesting class and great professor that teaches real life lessons. 100% would take again but do not take if you just want an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not as bad a professor as the reviews make him out to be, just wants the best out of his students. The class itself is tough but if you study you should be fine.

Doesn't teach you how to apply the material learned to the real world. His review helped for test (some test questions are recycled) but most of the answer for the review are "The answer is in your notes :)" If you try hard you can do well, but I'd take another Econ class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hoekstra is about as solid a professor as you can get. Not too much work assigned outside of class. A couple of readings and videos but most are pretty interesting. Test are usually fairly straight forward. He can be a bit monotone during his lectures but the material is interesting and he's a pretty cool and reasonable person if any problems arise

reviews.comment: Super tough grader. Literally expects you to write verbatim what he said in class to get credit. Also, there is a quiz every class over the previous lecture.
